result.detail: Open point: the four sections say the nonce arrives as a plusarg but do not name it. The testbench tries NIRMAAN_NONCE=, nirmaan_nonce=, nonce= and NONCE=, in that order. If none is present it counts a failure and prints an error, so a wrong guess fails the run visibly rather than silently. If the platform uses another name, the $value$plusargs calls near the end of the file must be updated; I can escalate to verification.dynamic.testbench.tech_lead for the exact name if needed. The nonce is printed one character at a time with NUL bytes skipped, so it prints the same in both simulators. Only the testbench calls $finish. Random stimulus uses a fixed xorshift32 seed (32'h1234ABCD), so runs repeat exactly. Independent review is still required before approval; I have not reviewed or approved this myself.
